Name: MAFAULDA Machinery Fault Database
Summary: Vibration, tachometer and microphone recordings of 1951 runs on a SpectraQuest rotor rig under normal, imbalance, misalignment and bearing-fault states.
Publisher: Signals, Multimedia, and Telecommunications Laboratory, COPPE/Poli/UFRJ
Description:
MAFAULDA is a database of multivariate time series recorded on a SpectraQuest Alignment-Balance-Vibration Trainer (ABVT) Machinery Fault Simulator. It is published by the Signals, Multimedia, and Telecommunications Laboratory of COPPE/Poli/UFRJ and holds 1951 sequences covering six states: normal operation, imbalance, horizontal and vertical misalignment, and bearing faults.

Each sequence lasts 5 s at 50 kHz, totalling 250,000 samples. The 8 CSV columns hold a tachometer signal, axial, radial and tangential accelerations at the underhang and overhang bearings, and a microphone. Imbalance uses loads from 6 g to 35 g, and horizontal misalignment shifts the motor shaft by 0.5 to 2.0 mm.

Three defective bearings, with faults on the outer track, rolling elements or inner track, are mounted one at a time between rotor and motor (underhang) or outside the rotor (overhang), with masses of 6, 20 and 35 g added to make the faults detectable. This gives 558 underhang and 513 overhang sequences. Each subset downloads separately or as one 13.0 GB package.
